### Patch Changes

hot_issues.title: Agendash shows wrong dates on "All jobs" page
MongoDB findAndLockNextJob index doesn't perform well
Make the agenda/testing package available for testing conformance of custom backends.
repeatAt ignores repeatTimezone (wrong wall-clock time on non-local servers)
job.touch() without an argument wipes progress
async notification handler errors are swallowed

discussions.title: How to query for jobs created within a certain date range?
We are moving our Microservices in JS to move from from Node JS 8 to 20 which agenda lib we should use
Does it run past scheduled events if the service wasnt running?
